A branch focused on litigation

The Italian branch of the Circosta Law Firm is strongly focused on litigation, with extensive experience in representing clients before civil, criminal, administrative and accounting courts.

Assistance at every stage of litigation

We assist clients at every stage of litigation:

  • from preliminary investigations and precautionary measures in criminal proceedings;
  • to civil disputes concerning contracts, liability and inheritance;
  • up to appeals before the Regional Administrative Courts (TAR) and the Court of Auditors on matters of administrative law and public accounting justice.

Our strength

Our strength lies in providing an effective, tailored defence, combining legal precision with practical knowledge of Italian judicial practice, while also taking into account connections with European and international frameworks.
